title: Physical phase-overlap residency under one kernel quota
question: Can phase-separated FAULT_IN preserve the same four-worker concurrency class under a kernel memory quota that kills KEEP_WARM because of simultaneous lifetime overlap?
preregistered_gates: both residency modes complete under high quota
job digests and phase-A workspace signatures match across modes
measured KEEP_WARM and FAULT_IN peaks differ by at least 8 MiB
tight quota is derived strictly between measured FAULT_IN required peak and KEEP_WARM floor
KEEP_WARM triggers isolated kernel OOM under tight quota
FAULT_IN completes under the same tight quota with zero OOM kills
same four workers and same kernel quota are used for the rescue comparison
authority and retry authority remain unchanged
